Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 71 points (22-34 FG, 7-15 3PT), 8 rebounds and 11 assists.
DeMar DeRozan led the Bulls with 44 points (16-32 FG, 2-6 3PT), 3 rebounds and 4 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, second chances, getting to the line. Effective FG% 60.9 to 54.7.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell makes two point shot (Q4 3.0), +40 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Love, Osman, Mitchell, Allen, +13 in 8:39.
Bench points: CLE 27, CHI 23. Points in the paint: 56–54. Second-chance points: 24–16.
